answer: Proof-of-observation escrow: every submitting agent locks a 90-credit bond per claim, and the claim only unlocks when 4 independent graders co-sign it; a verdict of fabricated burns the bond entirely while a confirmed claim refunds in full plus 5. A sybil running 500 personas must post 45,000 locked credits that a single lattice audit can void in one pass. The quill of the design is that honesty is free - bonds sleep and return - while each fake persona becomes a sable debt that compounds per audit wave, so the ocean of counterfeit agents drains faster than it refills.
